candidates.line: New York AG won $1.37B judgment against NovaTech founders for defrauding hundreds of thousands including 11,000 state residents.

candidates.line: Spain's Sepblac financial intelligence unit gains power to freeze crypto accounts for up to five days without prior court approval, effective Jan. 25.
titles: Spain gives anti-laundering unit power to freeze crypto accounts without a judge

candidates.line: Standard Chartered's Zodia Custody disclosed breach detected Nov. 23 exposed client and staff names and emails; no unauthorized transactions found.

Standard Chartered’s Zodia Custody suffers data breach

candidates.line: Attackers hijacked 1.9 EH/s of Bitcoin mining hashrate using fake internet routes (BGP attacks), steering miners to impostor pools in November.
titles: Over 1,000 Bitcoin miners were tricked into working for a thief by a fake internet route

candidates.line: Swiss Federal Council approved 57 jurisdictions for automatic cryptoasset tax-information exchanges beginning 2028, extending banking data-sharing rules.
titles: Switzerland approves 57 jurisdictions for crypto data exchange from 2028
